blocks.text: Cloverdale Townhomes Under $1.2M — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: What types of townhomes are available under $1.2M in Cloverdale?
The sub-$1.2M range covers the core townhome inventory in
Cloverdale

and Clayton, including 3-storey wood-frame townhouses (1,250–1,650 sq ft) with 2 or 3 bedrooms, larger end-unit 3-bedroom-plus-rec-room layouts (1,650–2,000 sq ft), and older 2-level complexes near 64 Avenue and 176 Street.
What is the difference between tandem and side-by-side garages in Cloverdale townhomes?

Tandem garages park two vehicles end-to-end under a narrower 12- to 14-foot building footprint, which is common in 3-storey Clayton townhomes. Side-by-side double garages sit side-by-side under a wider footprint and allow either vehicle to exit independently, often paired with a full-length driveway Apron in older or wider complexes.
Are driveway parking aprons permitted in Cloverdale townhome complexes?

Whether you can park on the concrete apron outside your garage depends on the complex's registered Strata Plan and Bylaws. Some strata corporations designate driveway aprons as Limited Common Property for the unit's use, while others prohibit apron parking to preserve fire-lane turning radius.
What are typical monthly strata fees for Cloverdale townhomes?

Monthly strata fees for Cloverdale townhomes typically fall between $260 and $460 depending on complex age, landscaping scope, snow removal, and whether the development includes a clubhouse or amenity building. Always review the Form B Information Certificate and Depreciation Report before removing conditions.
How close are Cloverdale townhomes to the future Surrey-Langley SkyTrain stations?

Townhome pockets along Fraser Highway and in East Clayton sit nearest the planned 184 Street and 190 Street SkyTrain stations along the 16-kilometre Expo Line extension to Langley City Centre, while central Cloverdale complexes connect via 64 Avenue, 176 Street (Highway 15), and Highway 10.
Which School District 36 schools serve Cloverdale townhome neighbourhoods?

Cloverdale and Clayton are served by Surrey School District 36 secondary schools Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary, Clayton Heights Secondary, and Salish Secondary (including French Immersion), along with numerous local elementary catchments. Verify exact street-address catchment boundaries with SD36 before making an offer.
How do Cloverdale townhomes under $1.2M compare with detached homes under $1.8M?
Townhomes under $1.2M reduce exterior maintenance through strata-managed roofing and grounds, whereas
Cloverdale detached homes under $1.8M
provide freehold lots, private yards, and frequent basement suite or coach-house configurations without monthly strata fees.
